notes: «بهذا الإسناد» sits mid-chain and no previous report is in the context, so nothing is inherited; written as it stands.
«قلت لأبي عبد الله النداء حق؟» : Zurara asks the Imam, who answers, so the Imam is the last link (owner ruling 2).
«وقال: لا يكون هذا الأمر» is a second saying of the Imam on the same isnad: one group, no new transmitter.
